title: Audit every shipped dependency set in the local PowerShell gate
objective: Make scripts/check.ps1 mirror the dependency-audit job in .github/workflows/ci.yml so local success covers both shipped Python requirement sets, development Python dependencies, root Node tooling, and the separate apps/web Node install.
out_of_scope_zero_diff: promotion or merge of the draft pull request
acceptance_criteria: A1: With -NodeAudit, scripts/check.ps1 runs five separately named dependency checks matching CI: apps/api Python production, apps/worker Python production, Python development, repo-root Node, and apps/web Node.
A2: Python commands exactly match CI's pip-audit -r invocation shape and requirement paths.
A3: Both Node commands are npm audit --audit-level=high with development dependencies included; the apps/web command runs with apps/web as its working directory.

A4: The NodeAudit switch retains its existing semantics: all Python audits always run, while both Node audits run only when the switch is supplied; a bare run prints visually distinct skip notices naming both omitted Node audits.

A5: A scoped audit restores the prior working directory in a finally block even when npm audit fails, while Invoke-Check continues accumulating failures and preserves the script's existing exit semantics.

A6: Against the pre-fix vulnerable apps/web lock blob 62ece10e283a1765c751c712553b4135650f7018, the old gate exits 0 while the new gate exits non-zero and names Audit Node dependencies (apps/web); the tracked lock restores byte-exactly to f492053a91df9a977f6fda838ee82c6c38f5eda7.

A7: Planted failures in apps/api/requirements.txt, apps/worker/requirements.txt, and apps/web/package-lock.json each fail under the exact named check and every file restores to its original blob hash.
A8: The clean full local gate exits 0, prints all five audit names separately, and reports every audit clean.
A9: Draft PR CI has all five checks green; the Dependency audit job has fourteen successful steps including all five named audit steps.
A10: The diff is limited to scripts/check.ps1, this contract, and an append-only agent-state/progress.md entry; progress remains a strict base-prefix append ending in LF.
verification_plan: Run the pre-fix vulnerable-lock control and retain old/new gate logs plus blob hashes in session artifacts.
Run planted-failure controls for apps/api, apps/worker, and apps/web with restoration in finally blocks and verify byte-exact hashes.
Run the gate without -NodeAudit and require two named Node skip notices; run with -NodeAudit and require neither notice.
Run scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit end to end on the clean tree and inspect all five named audit checks.
Run a fresh Level 1 evaluator against this contract, the implementation diff, and control evidence.
Commit, push, open a draft pull request, wait for CI, and inspect exact dependency-job step names and conclusions.
negative_tests: A known vulnerable apps/web dev dependency must fail the apps/web audit but was invisible to the old gate.
A known vulnerable requirement in each production Python set must fail only its exact named audit.
A failing apps/web audit must leave the caller in the repository root.
data_implications: None. No schema, migration, application data, manifest, or lockfile change is permitted.
security_privacy: This closes a local supply-chain audit blind spot. No suppression, ignore flag, threshold reduction, force flag, secret, credential, or new network behavior is added.
portability: The implementation remains PowerShell 5.1-compatible, resolves paths from PSScriptRoot, prefers local .venv tools, and uses try/finally for working-directory restoration.
z0_risk: None. No provider, offer, quota, pricing, or classification behavior changes.
